Ghaib ki paanch baatein: Yeh Ghaib ki woh kunjiyaan hain jin ka ilm bajuz Allah Ta'ala ke kisi aur ko nahi. Magar is ke baad ke Allah isey ilm ata farmaye. Qiyamat ke aane ka sahi waqt na koi Nabi-e-Mursal jaane na koi muqarrab farishta, is ka waqt sirf Allah hi jaanta hai. Isi tarah baarish kab aur kahan aur kitni barsey gi is ka ilm bhi kisi ko nahi, haan jab farishton ko hukm hota hai jo is par muqarrar hain tab woh jaante hain aur jisay Allah maloom karaye. Isi tarah haamila ke pait mein kya hai? Isay bhi sirf Allah hi jaanta hai ke nar hoga ya mada, larka hoga ya larki, naik hoga ya bad? Isi tarah kisi ko yeh bhi maloom nahi ke kal woh kya karega? Na kisi ko yeh ilm hai ke woh kahan marega? Aur aayat mein hai: (Wa indahu mafatihul-ghaibi la ya'lmuha illa huwa - 6:59) Ghaib ki kunjiyaan Allah hi ke paas hain jinhein bajuz us ke aur koi nahi jaanta. Aur Hadees mein hai ke Ghaib ki kunjiyaan yahan paanch cheezein hain jin ka bayaan aayat (Innallaha indahu ilmu-sa'ati wa yunazzilul-gaithe wa ya'lmu ma fil-arhami, wa ma tadry nafsun maza taksibu ghadan, wa ma tadry nafsun bi-ayyi ardin tamootu, innallaha 'aleemun khabeer - 31:34) mein hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai: Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya paanch baatein hain jinhein Allah Ta'ala ke siva koi nahi jaanta, phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi. Bukhari ki Hadees ke alfaaz to yeh hain ke yeh paanch Ghaib ki kunjiyaan hain jinhein Allah ke siva koi nahi jaanta. Musnad Ahmad mein Huzoor ﷺ ka farmaan hai tujhe har cheez ki kunjiyaan di gayi hain siwaaye paanch ke, phir yehi aayat aap ne parhi.

Hadrat Abu Hurairah ؓ farmate hain Huzoor hamari majlis mein baithe hue the ke ek sahib tashreef laye aur poochne lage imaan kya cheez hai? Aap ne farmaya Allah ko, farishton ko, kitabon ko, rasoolon ko, aakhirat ko, marne ke baad ji uthne ko maan lena. Us ne poocha Islam kya hai? Farmaya ek Allah ki ibaadat karna, us ke saath kisi ko shareek na karna, namazein parhna, zakat dena, Ramzan ke rozey rakhna. Us ne daryaft kiya ehsan kya hai? Farmaya tera is tarah Allah ki ibaadat karna ke goya tu usey dekh raha hai aur agar tu nahi dekhta to woh tujhe dekh raha hai. Us ne kaha Huzoor Qiyamat kab hai? Farmaya is ka ilm na mujhe hai aur na tujhe hai, haan is ki kuch nishaniyan main tumhe bata deta hoon. Jab londi apne miyan ko janey aur jab nangey pairon aur nangey badanon waale logon ke sardaar ban jayein. Ilm-e-Qiyamat in paanch cheezon mein se ek hai jinhein Allah ke siva koi nahi jaanta, phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki. Woh shakhs wapas chala gaya, aap ne farmaya jao isey lota lao, log daud pare lekin woh kahin bhi nazar na aaya. Aap ne farmaya ke yeh Jibrael (A.S) thay, logon ko deen sikhane aaye thay (Bukhari). Hum ne is Hadees ka matlab Sahih Bukhari mein khoob bayaan kiya hai.

Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Jibril ne apni hatheliyan Huzoor ﷺ ke ghutnon par rakh kar yeh sawalat kiye thay. Ek sahih sanad ke sath Musnad Ahmad mein marwi hai ke Bani Amir qabeela ka ek shakhs An-Hazrat ﷺ ke paas aaya kehne laga main aaun? Aapne apne khadim ko bheja ke ja kar inhein adab sikhao yeh ijazat mangna nahi jaante. Inse kaho pehle salam karo phir daryaft karo ke main aa sakta hoon? Unhon ne sun liya aur usi tarah salam kiya aur ijazat chahi. Yeh gaye aur jaakar kaha aap hamare liye kya lekar aaye hain? Aap ne farmaya bhalayi hi bhalayi. Suno tum ek Allah ki ibadat karo Lat-o-Uzza ko chhor do din raat mein paanch namazein parha karo saal bhar mein ek mahine ke rozay rakho apne maal-daron se zakat wasool karke apne faqeeroun par taqseem karo. Unhon ne daryaft kiya Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ kya ilm mein se kuch aisa baqi hai jise aap na jaante hon? Aap ne farmaya haan aisa ilm bhi hai jise bajuz Allah Ta'ala ke koi nahi jaanta. Phir aap ne yehi aayat parhi. 

Mujahid farmate hain gaanv ke rehne wale ek shakhs ne aakar Huzoor ﷺ se daryaft kiya tha ke meri aurat hamal se hai batlaye kya bacha hoga? Hamare shehar mein qahat hai farmayiye barish kab hogi? Yeh to main nahi jaanta ke main kab paida hua lekin yeh aap maloom kara dijiye ke kab marunga? Uske jawab mein yeh aayat utri ke mujhe in cheezon ka mutlaq ilm nahi. Mujahid farmate hain yehi ghaib ki kunjiyaan hain jin ke bare mein farman-e-bari hai ke ghaib ki kunjiyan sirf Allah hi ke paas hain. 

Hazrat Siddiqa ؓ farmati hain jo tumse kahe ke Rasool Allah ﷺ kal ki baat ka ilm jaante thay to samajh lena ke woh sabse bara jhoota hai. Allah Ta'ala farmate hain ke koi nahi jaanta ke kal kya hoga? 

Qatadah farmate hain ke bohat si cheezein aisi hain jinka ilm Allah Ta'ala ne kisi ko nahi diya na Nabi ko na farishte ko. Allah hi ke paas qayamat ka ilm hai koi nahi jaanta ke kis saal kis mahine kis din ya kis raat mein woh aayegi. Isi tarah barish ka ilm bhi uske siva kisi ko nahi ke kab aaye? Aur koi nahi jaanta ke hamla ke pet mein bacha nar hoga ya mada surkh hoga ya siyah? Aur koi nahi jaanta ke kal woh neki karega ya badi karega? Marega ya jiye ga bohat mumkin hai kal maut ya aafat aa jaye. Na kisi ko yeh khabar hai ke kis zameen mein woh dabaya jayega ya samundar mein bahaya jayega ya jangal mein marega ya narm ya sakht zameen mein jaye ga. 

Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai jab kisi ko maut dusri zameen mein hoti hai to uska wahin ka koi kaam nikal aata hai aur wahin maut aa jati hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh farma kar Rasool Kareem ﷺ ne yeh aayat parhi. A'sha Hamdan ke shair hain jin mein is mazmoon ko nihayat khubsurati se ada kiya hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke qayamat ke din zameen Allah Ta'ala se kahegi ke yeh hain teri amanatein jo tune mujhe sonp rakhi thien. Tabarani waghera mein bhi yeh hadith hai.

Suraton ke shuru mein jo Huroof-e-Muqatta'at hain un ki poori behas hum Surah Al-Baqarah ke shuru mein kar chuke hain. Yahan dobara bayaan karne ki zaroorat nahi. Yeh Kitab-e-Quran-e-Hakeem beshak-o-shubha Allah Rabb-ul-Alamin ki taraf se nazil hua hai. Mushrikin ka yeh qaul ghalat hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khud ise ghad liya hai. Nahi, yeh to yaqinan Allah ki taraf se hai is liye utra hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us qoum ko darawe ke sath aagah kar dein jin ke paas aap se pehle koi aur paighambar nahi aaya. Taake woh haq ki اتباع karke nijaat hasil kar lein.

Har ek ki nakeil Allah Jalla Shanuhu ke haath mein hai, tamaam cheezon ka khaliq Allah hai. Us ne chhe din mein zameen o aasman banaye phir arsh par qarar pakra. Is ki tafsir guzar chuki hai. Malik o khaliq wahi hai, har cheez ki nakeil usi ke haath mein hai. Tadbirein sab kaamon ki wahi karta hai, har cheez par ghalba usi ka hai. Us ke siwa makhlooq ka na koi wali na us ki ijazat ke baghair koi sifarishi. Ae woh logo jo is ke siwa auron ki ibadat karte ho, doosron par bharosa karte ho, kya tum nahi samajh sakte ke itni bari qudraton wala kyun kisi ko apna shareek-e-kar banane laga? Woh barabari se, wazir o mushir se, shareek o saheem se paak, munazzah aur mubra hai. Us ke siwa koi mabood nahi na us ke ilawa koi paalanhaar hai. Nasai mein hai Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A farmate hain, mera haath thaam kar Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya: Allah Ta'ala ne zameen o aasman aur un ke darmiyan ki tamaam cheezein paida karke saatwein din arsh par qiyam kiya. Mitti hafte ke din bani, pahad itwar ke din, darakht somwar ke din, buraiyan mangal ke din, noor budh ke din, janwar jumerat ke din, Adam jumma ke din asr ke baad din ki aakhri ghari mein ise tamaam roo-e-zameen ki mitti se paida kiya jis mein safed o siyah achhi buri har tarah ki thi, isi baais aulad-e-Aadam bhi bhali buri hui. Imam Bukhari ise mo'allal batlate hain, farmate hain aur sanad se marwi hai ke Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A ne ise Ka'b Ahbar se bayan kiya hai aur hazrat muhaddiseen ne bhi ise mo'allal batlaya hai. Wallahu A'lam. Is ka hukm saton aasmanon ke upar se utarta hai aur saton zameenon ke neeche tak pahunchta hai, jaisa aur ayat mein hai: (Allahul-lazhi khalaqa sab'a samawatin wa minal-ardi mithlahunna yat-anazzalul-amru bainahunna lita'lamoo annallaha 'ala kulli shai'in qadeerun wa annallaha qad ahata bi-kulli shai'in 'ilma 12) (Surah (At-Talaq: 12). Allah Ta'ala ne saat aasman banaye aur unhi ke misl zemeenein, is ka hukm un sab ke darmiyan utarta hai. Aamal apne deewan ki taraf uthaye aur chadhaaye jaate hain jo aasman-e-dunya ke upar hai. Zameen se aasman-e-awal paanch sau saal ke fasle par hai aur itna hi is ka ghairao hai. Itna utarna chadhna Allah ki qudratt se farishta ek aankh jhapakne mein kar leta hai. Isi liye farmaya: "Ek din mein jis ki miqdaar tumhari ginti ke aitbaar se ek hazaar saal ki hai." In umoor ka mudabbir Allah hai, woh apne bando ke aamal se ba-khabar hai. Sab chhote bare amal us ki taraf chadhte hain. Woh ghalib hai jis ne har cheez ko apne matahat kar rakha hai, kul bande aur kul gardanein us ke samne jhuki hui hain, woh apne momin bando par bahut hi meharbaan hai, azeez hai apni rahmat mein aur raheem hai apni izzat mein.)

Behtareen Khaliq, behtareen musawwir-o-mudawwir farmata hai: Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne har cheez ko qareenay se, behtareen taur se, tarkeeb par khoobsurat banayi hai. Har cheez ki paidaish kitni umdah, kaisi mustahkam aur mazboot hai! Aasmaan-o-zameen ki paidaish ke saath hi khud insaan ki paidaish par ghaur karo. Uska shuru dekho ke mitti se paida huwa hai. Abu-ul-Bashar Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) mitti se paida huwe thay, phir unki nasl nutfay se jaari rakhi jo mard ki peeth aur aurat ke seene se nikalta hai. Phir use yaani Adam ko mitti se paida karne ke baad theek-thaak aur durust kiya aur usmein apne paas ki rooh phoonki. Tumhein kaan, aankh, samajh ata farmai. Afsos ke phir bhi tum shukr-guzaari mein kasrat nahi karte. Nek anjaam aur khush-naseeb woh shakhs hai jo Allah ki di huwi taaqaton ko usi ki raah mein kharch karta hai. Jalla Shanuhu wa Azza Ismuhu.

Insaan aur farishton ka sath kuffar ka aqeedah bayan ho raha hai ke woh marne ke baad jeene ke qail nahin. Aur ise woh muhaal jaante hain aur kehte hain ke jab hamare reze reze juda hojayenge aur mitti mein mil kar mitti hojayenge phir bhi kya hum naye sire se banaye jasakte hain. Afsos yeh log apne upar Allah ko bhi qiyas karte hain aur apni mehdood qudrat par Allah ki na-maloom qudrat ka andaza karte hain. Maante hain jaante hain ke Allah ne awwal baar paida kiya hai. Tajajub hai phir dobara paida karne par use qudrat kyun nahi maante? Halanki iska toh sirf farmaan chalta hai. Jahaan kaha yun hoja wahin hogaya. Isi liye farmadiya ke unhe apne parvardigar ki mulaqat se inkaar hai. Uske baad farmaya ke Malik-ul-Maut jo tumhari rooh qabz karne par muqarrar hain tumhe faut karde hain. Is ayat mein bazahir toh yahi maloom hota hai ke Malik-ul-Maut aik farishte ka laqab hai. Hazrat Bara R.A ki woh hadith jiska bayan Surah Ibrahim mein guzar chuka hai usse bhi pehli baat samajh mein aati hai aur baaz asaar mein unka naam Azraeel bhi aaya hai aur yahi mashhoor hai. Haan unke sathi aur unke sath kaam karne wale farishte bhi hain jo jism se rooh nikaalte hain aur narkhare tak pahunch jane ke baad Malik-ul-Maut use le lete hain. Unke liye zameen samet di gayi hain aur aisi hi hai jaise hamare samne koi tashtari rakhi hui ho. Ke jo chaha uthaliya. Aik mursal hadith bhi is mazmoon ki hai. Ibn Abbas R.A ka maqoola bhi hai. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke aik Ansari ke sarhane Malik-ul-Maut ko dekh kar Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya Malik-ul-Maut mere sahabi ke sath aasani kijiye. Aap ne jawab diya ke A Allah ke Nabi taskeen-e-khatir rakhiye aur dil khush kijiye wallah main khud ba-eeman aur nihayat narmi karne wala hoon. Suno! Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ qasam hai Allah ki tamam duniya ke har kache pakke ghar mein khwah woh khushki mein ho ya tari mein har din mein mere paanch phere hote hain. Har chhote bade ko main isse bhi zyada jaanta hoon jitna woh apne aap ko jaanta hai. Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ yaqeen maaniye Allah ki qasam main toh aik machhar ki jaan qabz karne ki bhi qudrat nahi rakhta jab tak mujhe Allah ka hukum na ho. Phir qayamat ke din sab ka lautna Allah ki taraf hai qabron se nikal kar maidan-e-mahshar mein Allah ke samne hazir ho kar apne apne kiye ka phal pana hai.

Insaan aur farishton ka sath kuffar ka aqeedah bayan ho raha hai ke woh marne ke baad jeene ke qail nahin. Aur ise woh muhaal jaante hain aur kehte hain ke jab hamare reze reze juda hojayenge aur mitti mein mil kar mitti hojayenge phir bhi kya hum naye sire se banaye jasakte hain. Afsos yeh log apne upar Allah ko bhi qiyas karte hain aur apni mehdood qudrat par Allah ki na-maloom qudrat ka andaza karte hain. Maante hain jaante hain ke Allah ne awwal baar paida kiya hai. Tajajub hai phir dobara paida karne par use qudrat kyun nahi maante? Halanki iska toh sirf farmaan chalta hai. Jahaan kaha yun hoja wahin hogaya. Is ayat mein bazahir toh yahi maloom hota hai ke Malik-ul-Maut aik farishte ka laqab hai. Haan unke sathi aur unke sath kaam karne wale farishte bhi hain jo jism se rooh nikaalte hain aur narkhare tak pahunch jane ke baad Malik-ul-Maut use le lete hain. Unke liye zameen samet di gayi hain aur aisi hi hai jaise hamare samne koi tashtari rakhi hui ho. Ke jo chaha uthaliya. Aik mursal hadith bhi is mazmoon ki hai. Ibn Abbas R.A ka maqoola bhi hai. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke aik Ansari ke sarhane Malik-ul-Maut ko dekh kar Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya Malik-ul-Maut mere sahabi ke sath aasani kijiye. Aap ne jawab diya ke A Allah ke Nabi taskeen-e-khatir rakhiye aur dil khush kijiye wallah main khud ba-eeman aur nihayat narmi karne wala hoon. Suno! Na-aqibat andisho ab khumyaza bhugtu! Allah Ta'ala farmate hain ke jab yeh gunahgaar apna dobara jeena khud apni ankhon se dekh lenge aur nihayat zillat-o-haqarat ke sath nadam ho kar gardanein jhukaye sar dale Allah ke samne khade honge. Us waqt kahenge ke اے Allah hamari ankhein roshan hogayin, kaan khul gaye. Ab hum tere ahkaam ki baja-avari ke liye har tarah taiyar hain. Us din khoub soch samajh wale dana-bina hojayenge. Sab andha-o-behra pan jata rahega, khud apne taiyan malamat karne lagenge aur jahannam mein jate hue kahenge hamen phir duniya mein bhej de to hum naik amaal kar ayenge, hamen ab yaqeen hogaya hai ke teri mulaqat sach hai, tera kalam haq hai. Lekin Allah ko khoub maloom hai ke yeh log agar dobara bhi bheje jayen to yahi harkat karenge. Phir se Allah ki ayton ko jhutlayenge, dobara nabiyon ko satayenge. Jaise ke khud Quran Kareem ki ayat (وَلَوْ تَرٰٓي اِذْ وُقِفُوْا عَلَي النَّارِ فَقَالُوْا يٰلَيْتَنَا نُرَدُّ وَلَا نُكَذِّبَ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّنَا وَنَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ) (Surah (Al-An'am: 27) mein hai. Isisi liye yahan farmata hai ke agar hum chahte to har shakhs ko hidayat de dete, jaise farman hai: Agar tera Rab chahta to zameen ka ek ek rehne wala momin ban jata. Lekin Allah ka yeh faisla sadir hochuka hai ke insan aur jinaat se jahannam par hona hai. Allah ki zat aur us ke poore-poore kalimat ka yeh atal amr hai. Hum us ke tamam azabon se panah chahte hain. Dozatiyon se bator sarzish ke kaha jayega ke is din ki mulaqat ki faromoshi ka maza chakho aur us ke jhutlane ka khumyaza bhugtu. Ise muhal samajh kar tum ne woh mamla kiya ke jo har ek bhoolne wala kiya karta hai. Ab hum bhi tumhare sath yahi salook karenge. Allah ki zat haqiqi niseyan aur bhool se pak hai. Yeh to sirf badle ke taur par farmaya gaya hai. Chunancha aur riwayat mein bhi hai ayat: (وَقِيْلَ الْيَوْمَ نَنْسٰـىكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيْتُمْ لِقَاۗءَ يَوْمِكُمْ ھٰذَا وَمَاْوٰىكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ نّٰصِرِيْنَ) (Surah (Al-Jathiyah: 34) Aaj hum tumhen bhool jate hain. Jaise aur ayat mein hai: (لَا يَذُوْقُوْنَ فِيْهَا بَرْدًا وَّلَا شَرَابًا) (Surah (An-Naba: 24) Wahan thandak aur pani na rahega siwaye garam pani aur lahoo peep ke aur kuch na hoga.)))

Imaandar wohi hai jis ke aamal tabey Quran hon! Sache imaandaron ki nishaani yeh hai ke woh dil ke kaanon se hamari aayaton ko sunte hain aur un par amal karte hain. Zubani haq maante hain aur dil se bhi barhaq jaante hain. Sajda karte hain aur apne Rab ki tasbeeh aur hamd bayaan karte hain. Aur itteba-e-haq se jee nahi churaate. Na akadte zidd karte hain. Yeh bida'at kafiron ki hai jaise farmaya aayat: (Innal-lazina yastakbiroona ‘an ‘ibadati sayadkhuloona jahannama dakhireen 60) (Surah (Al-Ghafir: 60) yaani meri ibadat se takabbur karne wale zaleel-o-khwaar ho kar jahannam mein jayenge. In sache imaandaron ki ek yeh bhi alamat hai ke woh raaton ko neend chhod kar apne bistaron se alag ho kar namazein ada karte hain, tahajjud padhte hain. Maghrib Isha ke darmiyan ki namaz bhi baaz ne muraad li hain. Koi kehta hai muraad is se Isha ki namaz ka intezaar hai. Aur qaul hai ke Isha ki aur subha ki namazein ba-jama'at is se muraad hain. Woh Allah se duayein karte hain uske azabon se nijaat ke liye aur uski nematein haasil karne ke liye saath hi sadqa khairaat bhi karte rehte hain. Apni haisiyat ke mutabiq rah-e-Allah mein dete rehte hain. Woh nekiyan bhi karte hain jinka talluq unhi ki zaat se hai. Aur woh nekiyan bhi haath se jaane nahi dete jinka talluq doosron se hai. In behtareen nekiyon mein sab se badhe hue woh hain jo darjaat mein bhi sab se aage hain. Yaani Sayyid-e-Aulad-e-Adam Fakhr-e-Do-Jahan Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ. Jaise ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawaha ؓ ke sheron mein hai: (Wa feena Rasulullahi yatlu kitabhu, Iza anshaqa ma'roofun minas-subhi sati'u, Yabeetu yujafi janbahu ‘an firashihi, Iza-stathqalat bil-mushrikinal-madaji'u) yaani hum mein Allah ke Rasool ﷺ hain jo subha hote hi Allah ki paak kitab ki tilaawat karte hain. Raaton ko jabke mushrikeen gehri neend mein sote hain Huzoor ﷺ ki karwat aap ke bistar se alag hoti hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain Allah Ta'ala do shakhson se bahut hi khush hota hai: Ek to woh jo raat ko meethi neend soya hua hai lekin daf'atan apne Rab ki nematein aur uski sazayein yaad karke uth baithta hai apne narm-o-garm bistare ko chhod kar mere saamne khada ho kar namaz shuru kar deta hai. Doosra shakhs woh hai jo ek ghazway mein hai kafiron se ladte ladte musalmanon ka paansa kamzor padjata hai lekin yeh shakhs yeh samajh kar ke bhaagne mein Allah ki narazgi hai aur aage badhne mein Rab ki razaamandi hai maidan ki taraf lauthta hai aur kafiron se jihaad karta hai yahan tak ke apna sar uske naam par qurban kar deta hai. Allah Ta'ala fakhr se apne farishton ko ise dikhata hai aur uske saamne uske amal ki taarif karta hai. Musnad Ahmad Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal ؓ farmate hain main Nabi ﷺ ke sath ek safar mein tha subha ke waqt main aap ke qareeb hi chal raha tha maine poochha Aey Allah ke Nabi mujhe koi aisa amal bataiye jo mujhe jannat mein pohncha de aur jahannam se alag kar de, Aap ne farmaya tu ne sawal to bade kaam ka kiya hai lekin Allah jis par aasan kar de us par bada sahal hai.

Sun to Allah ki ibadat karta reh aur uske sath kisi ko sharik na kar namazon ki pabandi kar Ramadan ke rozੇ rakh Baitullah ka hajj kar zakat ada karta reh. Aa ab main tujhe bhalaion ke darwaze batlaon. Roza dhal hai aur insan ki adhi raat ki namaz, sadqa gunahon ko maaf kara deta hai. Phir Aap ne ayat (Tatafafa junubuhum 'anil-madaji'i yad'una rabbahum khawfan wa tama'an wa mimma razaqnahum yunfiqoon 16) (As-Sajdah: 16) ki tilawat farmai. Phir Aap ne farmaya aa ab main tujhe is Amr-e-Sir uske suton aur uski kohan ki bulandi bataon. Is tamam ka sir to Islam hai aur iska suton namaz hai iske kohan ki bulandi Allah ki rah ka jihad hai. Phir Aap ne farmaya ab main tujhe tamam kamon ke sardar ki khabar dun? Phir Aap ne apni zaban pakad kar farmaya ise rok rakh maine kaha kya hum apni baat-chit par bhi pakde jayenge? Aap ne farmaya Ae Mu'az afsos tujhe maloom nahi insan ko jahannam mein oundhe munh dalne wali cheez to iske zaban ke kinare hain. Yehi hadith kai sanadon se marwi hai ek mein yeh bhi hai ki is ayat (Tatafafa) ko padh kar Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya isse murad bande ka raat ki namaz padhna hai. Aur riwayat mein Huzoor ﷺ ka yeh farman marwi hai ki insan ka adhi raat ko qiyam karna. Phir Huzoor ka isi ayat ko tilawat karna marwi hai ek hadith mein hai ki Qiyamat ke din jabki awwal-o-akhir sab log maidan-e-mahshar mein jama honge to ek munadi farishta awaz buland karega jise tamam makhlooq sunegi. Woh kahega ki aaj sab ko maloom hojayega ki sab se zyada zi-izzat Allah ke nazdeek kaun hai? Phir laut kar awaz lagayega ki tahajjud guzar log uth khade hon aur is ayat ki tilawat farmayega to ye log uth khade honge aur ginti mein bahut kam honge. Hazrat Bilal ؓ farmate hain ki jab yeh ayat utri to hum log majlis mein baithe the. Aur ba'z Sahaba Maghrib ke baad se lekar Esha tak namaz mein mashghool rehte the pas yeh ayat nazil hui. Is hadith ki yehi ek sanad hai. Phir farmata hai unke liye jannat mein kya kya nematein aur lazzatein poshida poshida banakar rakhi hain. Isi ka kisi ko ilm nahi chunke ye log bhi poshida taur par ibadat karte the usi tarah humne bhi poshida taur par unki ankhon ki thandak aur unke dil ka sukh tayyar kar rakha hai jo na kisi ankh ne dekha aur na kisi dil mein iska khayal aya. Bukhari ki Hadith-e-Qudsi mein hai main ne apne naik bando ke liye woh rahmatein aur nematein mohayya kar rakhi hain jo na kisi ankh ke dekhne mein ayin na kisi kaan ke sunne mein na kisi ke dil ke sochne mein aye hon. Is hadith ko bayan farma kar Hazrat Abu Hurairah rawi-e-hadith ne kaha Quran ki is ayat ko padh lo. (Fala ta'lamu nafsun ma ukhfi lahum min qurrati a'yunin jaza'an bima kanu ya'maloon 17) (As-Sajdah: 17), is riwayat mein qurrat ke bajaye qura'at padhna bhi marwi hai.

Aur rivayat mein farman-e-Rasool ﷺ hai ke Jannat ki nematein jise milen woh kabhi bhi wapas nahi hongi. Unke kapre purane na honge, unki jawani dhale gi nahi, unke liye Jannat mein woh hai jo na kisi ankh ne dekha, na kisi kaan ne suna, na kisi insan ke dil par unka wahm-o-guman aya (Muslim). Ek hadith mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Jannat ka wasf bayan karte hue akhir mein yahi farmaya aur phir yeh ayat (TATAFA JUNOBUHUM ANIL-MADHAJI'I YAD'OUNA RABBAHUM KHAWFAN WA TAMA'AN WA MIMMA RAZAQNAHUM YUNFIQUN 16) (Surah (As-Sajdah: 16) ki tilawat farmayi. Hadith-e-Qudsi mein hai ke main ne apne nek bando ke liye aisi nematein taiyar ki hain jo na ankho ne dekhi hain na kano ne suni hain balki andaze mein bhi nahi asaktin. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya ke Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne Allah Ta'ala Rabb-e-Alamin Azzawajal se arz kiya ke A Bari Ta'ala! Adna Jannati ka darja kya hai? Jawab mila ke adna jannati woh shakhs hai jo kul jannatiyo ke Jannat mein chale jane ke baad ayega, us se kaha jayega Jannat mein dakhil ho jao, woh kahega Ya Allah kahan jaun, har ek ne apni jagah par qabza kar liya hai aur apni cheezein sambhal li hain. Us se kaha jayega ke kya tu is par khush hai ke tere liye itna ho jitna duniya ke kisi bahut bare badshah ke paas tha? Woh kahega Parvardigar! Main is par bahut khush hun. Allah Ta'ala farmayega tere liye itna hi aur itna hi aur itna hi aur panch guna. Yeh kahega bas bas A Rab! Main razi ho gaya. Allah Ta'ala farmayega yeh sab hum ne tujhe diya aur iska das guna aur bhi diya aur bhi jis cheez ko tera dil chahe aur jis cheez se teri ankhein thandi rahein. Yeh kahega Mere Parvardigar! Meri to bachein khil gayin, ji khush ho gaya. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne kaha phir Allah Ta'ala ala darja ke jannati ki kya کیفیت hai? Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya ke Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne Allah Ta'ala Rabb-e-Alamin Azzawajal se arz kiya ke A Bari Ta'ala! Adna Jannati ka darja kya hai? Jawab mila ke adna jannati woh shakhs hai jo kul jannatiyo ke Jannat mein chale jane ke baad ayega, us se kaha jayega Jannat mein dakhil ho jao, woh kahega Ya Allah kahan jaun, har ek ne apni jagah par qabza kar liya hai aur apni cheezein sambhal li hain. Us se kaha jayega ke kya tu is par khush hai ke tere liye itna ho jitna duniya ke kisi bahut bare badshah ke paas tha? Woh kahega Parvardigar! Main is par bahut khush hun. Allah Ta'ala farmayega tere liye itna hi aur itna hi aur itna hi aur panch guna. Yeh kahega bas bas A Rab! Main razi ho gaya. Allah Ta'ala farmayega yeh sab hum ne tujhe diya aur iska das guna aur bhi diya aur bhi jis cheez ko tera dil chahe aur jis cheez se teri ankhein thandi rahein. Yeh kahega Mere Parvardigar! Meri to bachein khil gayin, ji khush ho gaya. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne kaha phir Allah Ta'ala ala darja ke jannati ki kya کیفیت hai? Farmaya yeh woh log hain jin ki khatir-o-madarat ki karamat main ne apne hath se likhi aur is par apni mohar laga di hai, phir na to woh kisi ke dekhne mein ayi na kisi ke sunne mein na kisi ke khayal mein. Iska misdaq Allah ki kitab ki ayat (FALA TA'LAMU NAFSUM MA UKHIYA LAHUM MIN QURRATI A'YUNIN JAZA'AN BIMA KANU YA'MALUN 17) (Surah (As-Sajdah: 17) hai. Hazrat Abbas bin Abdul-Wahid farmate hain mujhe yeh baat pahunchi hai ke ek jannati apni hoor ke sath mohabbat-pyar mein sattar saal tak mashghool rahega, kisi dusri cheez ki taraf uska iltifat hi nahi hoga. Phir jab dusri taraf iltifat hoga to dekhega ke pehli se bahut zyada khubsurat aur noorani shakl ki ek aur hoor hai. Woh use apni taraf mutawajja dekh kar khush ho kar kahegi ke ab meri murad bhi puri hogi, yeh kahega tu kaun hai? Woh kahegi main Allah ki mazeed nemato mein se hun. Ab yeh sarapa uski taraf mutawajja ho jayega, phir sattar saal ke baad dusri taraf dekhega ke isse bhi achhi ek aur hoor hai, woh kahegi ab waqt agaya ke ap mein mera hissa bhi ho, yeh puchega tum kaun ho?

Woh jawab degi main un mein se hoon jin ki nisbat Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne farmaya hai koi nahi janta ke un ke liye Allah Ta'ala ne un ki ankhon ki kya kya thandak chupa rakhi hai. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.A farmate hain ke farishte jannatiyon ke paas duniya ke andaze se har din mein teen teen baar Jannat-e-Adan ke Allah ke tohfe lekar jayenge jo un ki jannat mein nahi usi ka bayan is ayat mein hai. Woh farishte un se kahenge ke Allah Ta'ala tum se khush hai. Hazrat Abu Al-Yaman Fazari ya kisi aur se marwi hai ke jannat ke sau darje hain pehla darja chandi ka hai is ki zameen bhi chandi ki hai is ke mahal bhi chandi ke is ki mitti mushk ki hai. Teesra moti ki, zameen bhi moti ki ghar bhi moti ke bartan bhi moti ke aur mitti mushk ki. Aur baqi satanwe toh woh hain jo na kisi ankh ne dekhi na kisi kaan ne sune na kisi insan ke dil mein guzre. Phir usi ayat ki tilawat farmayi. Ibn Jareer mein hai Anhadrat ﷺ Hazrat Rooh-ul-Ameen se riwayat karte hain ke insan ki nekiyan badiyan layi jayengi. Baaz baaz se kam ki jayengi phir agar ek neki bhi baqi bach gayi toh Allah Ta'ala use barha dega aur jannat mein kushadgi ata farmayega. Rawi ne Yazdad se pucha ke nekiyan kahan chali gayin? Toh unhon ne is ayat ki tilawat ki (Ula'ika alladhina nataqabbalu 'anhum ahsana ma 'amilu wa natajawazu 'an sayyi'atihim fi ashabil-jannati wa'das-sidqalladhi kanu yu'adun) 46. (Al-Ahqaf: 16) Yani yeh woh log hain jin ke achche amaal hum ne qubool farma liye aur un ki buraiyon se hum ne darguzar farma liya. Rawi ne kaha phir is ayat ke kya maani hain? (Fala ta'lamu nafsun ma ukhfi lahum min qurrati 'ayunin jaza'an bima kanu ya'malun) 32. (As-Sajdah: 17) Farmaya banda jab koi neki logon se chhupa kar karta hai toh Allah Ta'ala bhi Qiyamat ke din us ke araam ki khabrein jo us ke liye poshida rakh chhodi thin ata farmayega.)))

Nek-o-bad dono ek dusre ke ham-pala nahin ho sakte. Allah Ta'ala ke adl-o-karam ka bayan in ayton mein hai ki Uske nazdeek naik-kar aur bad-kar barabar nahin. Jaise farman hai ayat: (Am hasiballazinal-jatarahus-sayyi'ati an naj'alahum kallazina amanu wa amilus-salihati sawa'am mahyohum wa mamatuhum sa'a ma yahkumun) (Al-Jathiyah: 21) Yani kya un logon ne jo buraiyan kar rahe hain yeh samajh rakha hai ki hum unhen iman aur naik amal walon ki manind kar denge? Unki maut-o-ziyst barabar hai. Yeh kaise bure mansube bana rahe hain. Aur ayat mein hai: (Am naj'alullazinal-amnu wa amilus-salihati kal-mufsidina fil-ardi am naj'alul-muttaqina kal-fujjar) (Sad: 28) Yani imandar naik amal logon ko kya hum zameen ke fasadiyon ke ham-pala kar denge? Parhezgaron ko gunahgaron ke barabar kar denge? Aur ayat: (La yastawi ashabun-nari wa ashabul-jannati ashabul-jannati humul-fa'izun) (Al-Hashr: 20) Dozakhi aur Jannati barabar nahin ho sakte. 

Yahan bhi farmaya ki momin aur fasiq Qiyamat ke din ek martaba ke nahin honge. Kehte hain ki yeh ayat Hazrat Ali R.A aur Uqbah bin Abi Mu'ait ke bare mein nazil hui hai. Phir in dono qismon ka tafsili bayan farmaya ki jis ne apne dil se Kalamullah ki tasdiq ki aur uske mutabiq amal bhi kiya to unhen woh Jannatein milengi jin mein makanat hain, buland-bala khane hain aur rihaish aaram ke tamam saman hain. Yeh unki naik aamali ke badle mein mehmandari hogi. 

Aur jin logon ne ita'at chodi unki jagah Jahannam mein hogi jis mein se woh nikal na sakenge. Jaise aur ayat mein hai: (Kullama arada an yakhruju minha min ghammin u'idu fiha wa zuqu azabal-hariq) (Al-Hajj: 22) Yani jab kabhi wahan ke gham se chhutkara chahenge dobara wahin jhonk diye jayenge. 

Hazrat Fuzail bin Ayyaz R.H farmate hain: Wallah! Unke hath paon bandhe hue honge, aag ke shole unhen upar niche le ja rahe honge, farishte unhen sazayen kar rahe honge aur jhidak kar farmate honge ki is Jahannam ke azab ka lutf uthao jise tum jhootha jante the. 

Azab-e-adna se murad duniyawi museebatein, aafatein, dukh dard aur bimariyan hain, yeh isliye hoti hain ki insan hoshiyar ho jaye aur Allah ki taraf jhuk jaye aur bade azabon se najat hasil kare. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ki isse murad gunahon ki woh muqarrar karda sazayen hain jo duniya mein di jati hain jinhen shar'i istilah mein Hudood kehte hain. Aur yeh bhi marwi hai ki isse murad Azab-e-Qabr hai. 

Nisai mein hai ki isse murad qaht-saliyan hain. Hazrat Ubay R.H farmate hain: Chand ka shaq ho jana, dhuyen ka aana aur pakadna aur barbad-kun azab aur Badr wale din in kuffar ka qaid hona aur qatl kiya jana hai. Kyunki Badr ki is shikast ne Makkah ke ghar ghar ko matam-kadah bana diya tha.

Hazrat Fuzail bin Ayyaz R.H farmate hain: Wallah! Unke hath paon bandhe hue honge, aag ke shole unhen upar niche le ja rahe honge, farishte unhen sazayen kar rahe honge aur jhidak kar farmate honge ki is Jahannam ke azab ka lutf uthao jise tum jhootha jante the. 

Azab-e-adna se murad duniyawi museebatein, aafatein, dukh dard aur bimariyan hain, yeh isliye hoti hain ki insan hoshiyar ho jaye aur Allah ki taraf jhuk jaye aur bade azabon se najat hasil kare. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ki isse murad gunahon ki woh muqarrar karda sazayen hain jo duniya mein di jati hain jinhen shar'i istilah mein Hudood kehte hain. Aur yeh bhi marwi hai ki isse murad Azab-e-Qabr hai. 

Nisai mein hai ki isse murad qaht-saliyan hain. Hazrat Ubay R.H farmate hain: Chand ka shaq ho jana, dhuyen ka aana aur pakadna aur barbad-kun azab aur Badr wale din in kuffar ka qaid hona aur qatl kiya jana hai. Kyunki Badr ki is shikast ne Makkah ke ghar ghar ko matam-kadah bana diya tha.

In azaabon ki taraf is ayat mein ishara hai. Phir farmata hai jo Allah ki aayatein sun kar us ki wazahat ko paakar un se munh mod le balki un ka inkar kar jaye us se badh kar zalim aur kaun hoga? Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) farmate hain Allah ke zikr se araz na karo aisa karne wale be-izzat, be-waqsat aur bade gunahgar hain. Yahan bhi farman hota hai ki aise gunahgaron se hum zaroor intiqam lenge. Janab Rasool اللہ ﷺ ka farman hai teen kaam jis ne kiye woh mujrim ho gaya. Jis ne be-wajah koi jhanda bandha, jis ne maa baap ki nafarmani ki, jis ne zalim ke zulm mein us ka sath diya. Yeh mujrim log hain aur Allah ka farman hai ki hum mujrimon se baaz-purs karenge aur un se poora badla lenge. (Ibn Abi Hatim)

Farmata hai hum ne Musa ko kitab-e-Torat di to us ki mulaqat ke bare mein shak-o-shubah mein na reh. Qatadah farmate hain yani Meraj wali raat mein. Hadith mein hai main ne Meraj wali raat Hazrat Musa bin Imran ؑ ko dekha ke woh gandum-goon rang ke lambe qad ke ghongriyale baalon wale the aise jaise qabila Shanwah ke aadmi hote hain. Isi raat main ne Hazrat Isa ؑ ko bhi dekha woh darmiyana qad ke surkh-o-safaid the seedhe baal the. Main ne usi raat Hazrat Malik ko dekha jo Jahannam ke darogha hain aur Dajjal ko dekha yeh sab un nishaniyon mein se hain jo Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko dikhayen pas is ki mulaqat mein shak-o-shubah na kar. Aap ne yaqinan Hazrat Musa ko dekha aur un se mile jis raat aap ko Meraj karai gayi. Hazrat Musa ko hum ne Bani Israel ka hadi bana diya. Aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke is kitab ke zariye hum ne Israeliyon ko hidayat di. Jaise Surah Bani Israel mein hai ayat (Wa ataina musal-kitaba wa ja'alnahu hudan libani israila alla tattakhidu min duni wakila) (Al-Isra: 2) yani hum ne Musa ko kitab di aur Bani Israel ke liye hadi bana diya ke tum mere siwa kisi ko karsaz na samjho. Phir farmata hai ke chunke Allah Ta'ala ke ahkaam ki baja-awari us ki nafarmaniyon ke tark us ki baaton ki tasdeeq aur us ke rasoolon ki itba-o-sabr mein jame rahe hum ne un mein se ba'az ko hidayat ke peshwa bana diya jo Allah ke ahkaam logon ko pahunchate hain bhalai ki taraf bulate hain buraiyon se rokte hain. Lekin jab un ki halat badal gai unhon ne Kalamullah mein tabdili tahrif tawil shuru kar di to Allah Ta'ala ne bhi un se yeh manshab chheen liya un ke dil sakht kar diye amal-e-salih aur ittiqad-e-sahih un se door ho gaya. Pehle to yeh duniya se bache hue the Hazrat Sufiyan farmate hain yeh log pehle aise hi the lihaza insan ke liye zaroori hai ke us ka koi peshwa ho jis ki yeh iqtida karke duniya se bacha hua rahe aap farmate hain deen ke liye ilm zaroori hai jaise jism ke liye ghiza zaroori hai. Hazrat Sufiyan se Hazrat Ali R.A ke is qoul ke bare mein sawal hua ke sabr ki wajah se un ko aisa peshwa bana diya ke woh hamare hukm ki hidayat karte the. Aap ne farmaya matlab yeh hai ke chunke unhon ne tamam kaamon ko apne zimme le liya Allah ne bhi unhe peshwa bana diya. Chunacha farman hai hum ne Bani Israel ko kitab hikmat aur nubuwwat di aur pakeeza roziyan inayat farmaiyan aur jahan walon par fazilat di. Yahan bhi ayat ke aakhir mein farmaya ke jin aqaid-o-aamal mein un ka ikhtilaf hai un ka faisla qayamat ke din khud Allah karega.

Daryaye Neel ke naam Umar bin Khattab R.A ka khat 
Kya yeh is ke mulahiza ke baad bhi rah-e-rast par nahi chalte ke un se pehle ke gumraahon ko hum ne teh-o-bala kar diya hai. Aaj un ke nishanat mit gaye. Unhon ne bhi rasoolon ko jhutlaya Allah ki baaton se be-parwahi ki. Ab yeh jhutlane wale bhi un hi ke makanon mein rehte sehte hain. Un ki veerani un ke agle malikon ki halakat un ke samne hai. Lekin taham yeh ibrat hasil nahi karte. Isi baat ko Quran-e-Hakeem ne kai jagah bayan farmaya hai ke yeh ghair abad khandar yeh ujde hue mehlat to tumhari ankhon ko aur tumhare kanon ko kholne ke liye apne andar bohat si nishaniyan rakhte hain. Dekh lo ke Allah ki baatein na manne ka rasoolon ki taqeer karne ka kitna bad-anjaam hua? Kya tumhare kan un ki khabron se na-ashna hain. Phir Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala apne lutf-o-karam ko ehsan-o-inam ko bayan farma raha hai ke asman se pani utarata hai pahadon se unchi jaghon se simat kar nadi nalon aur daryahon ke zariye idhar udhar phail jata hai. Banjar ghair abad zameen mein is se hariyali hi hariyali ho jati hai. Khushki tari se mout zeest se badal jati hai. Go mufassireen ka qool yeh bhi hai ke jazr-e-misr ki zameen hai lekin yeh theek hai. Haan Misr mein bhi aisi zameen ho to ho ayat mein murad tamam woh hisse hain jo sookh gaye hon jo pani ke mohtaj ho sakht ho gaye hon zameen yaboosat (khushki) ke mare phatne lagi ho. Beshak Misr ki zameen bhi aisi hai Daryaye Neel se woh serab ki jati hai. Habash ki barishon ka pani apne sath surkh rang ki mitti ko bhi ghaseetta jata hai aur Misr ki zameen jo shor aur retli hai woh is pani aur is mitti se kheti ke qabil ban jati hai aur har saal par fasal ka ghalla taza pani se unhein mayassar ata hai jo idhar udhar ka hota hai. Is Hakeem-o-Kareem Mannan-o-Raheem ki yeh sab meharbaniyan hain. Isi ki zat qabil-e-tareef hai riwayat hai ke jab Misr fateh hua to Misr wale boyai ke mahine mein Hazrat Amr bin Aas R.A ke paas aaye aur kehne lage hamari qadeemi aadat hai ke is mahine mein kisi ko Daryaye Neel ki bhent charhate hain aur agar na charhayen to darya mein pani nahi ata. Hum aisa karte hain ke is mahine ki barah

Usi waqt Khalifat-ul-Muslimeen Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ki taraf se jawab milta hai ke aap ne jo kiya achha kiya ab main apne is khat mein ek parcha Darya-e-Neel ke naam bhej raha hoon tum ise lekar neel ke darya mein daal do. Hazrat Amr bin Aas R.A ne is parche ko nikaal kar padha toh us mein tahrir tha ke yeh khat Allah ke bande Amir-ul-Momineen Umar R.A ki taraf se ahl-e-Misr ke Darya-e-Neel ki taraf. Ba'd hamd-o-salawat ke matlab yeh hai ke agar tu apni taraf se aur apni marzi se chal raha hai tab toh khair na chal agar Allah Ta'ala Wahid-o-Qahhar tujhe jari rakhta hai toh hum Allah Ta'ala se dua maang rahe hain ke woh tujhe rawan karde. Yeh parcha lekar Hazrat Amir-e-Askar ne Darya-e-Neel mein daal diya. Abhi ek raat bhi guzarne nahi payi thi ke Darya-e-Neel mein solah haath gehra pani chalne laga aur usi waqt Misr ki khush-sali tar-sali se, girani arzani se badal gayi. Khat ke sath hi khatta ka khatta sarsabz ho gaya aur darya poori rawani se behta raha. Us ke baad se har saal jo jaan chadhai jati thi woh bach gayi aur Misr se is napak rasm ka hamesha ke liye khatma hua. (Kitab-us-Sunnah lil-Hafiz Abul-Qasim Al-Lalika'i) Usi ayat ke mazmoon ki ayat yeh bhi hai (Falyanzuril-insanu ila ta'amihi) (Surah (Abasa: 24) Yaani insan apni ghiza ko dekhe ke hum ne barish utari aur zamin phaad kar anaj aur phal paida kiye usi tarah yahan bhi farmaya ke yeh log ise nahi dekhte? Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain jarz woh zamin hai jis par barish nakafi barsti hai phir nalon aur nahron ke pani se woh siraab hoti hai. Mujahid R.H farmate hain yeh zamin Yaman mein hai, Hasan farmate hain aisi bastiyan Yaman aur Sham mein hain. Ibn Zaid waghera ka qaul hai yeh woh zamin hai jis mein paidawar na ho aur ghubar alood ho. Usi ko is ayat mein bayan farmaya hai (Wa ayatun lahumul-ardul-maytatu ahyaynaha wa akhrajna minha habban faminhu ya'kulun) (Surah (Ya-Sin: 33) Un ke liye murda zamin bhi ek nishani hai jise hum zinda kar dete hain.))

Nafarman apni barbadi ko aap bulawa deta hai. Kafir aitrazaan kaha karte the ke Aye Nabi ﷺ tum jo hamein kaha karte ho aur apne sathiyon ko bhi mutma'in kar diya hai ke tum hum par fatah paoge aur hum se badle loge, woh waqt kab aayega? Hum toh muddaton se tumhein maghlob, zer aur be-wuqat dekh rahe hain. Chup rahe ho, dar rahe ho, agar sache ho toh apne ghalbe ka aur apni fatah ka waqt batao. Allah farmata hai ke jab azaab-e-Ilahi aa jayega aur jab iska gussa aur ghazab utar padta hai, khwah duniya mein ho khwah aakhirat mein, us waqt na toh iman nafa deta hai na mohlat milti hai. Jaise farman hai ayat: (Falamma ja'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyinati farihu bima 'indahum minal-'ilmi wa haqqa bihim ma kanu bihi yastahzi'un) (Ghafir: 83) Yaani jab un ke paas Allah ke paighambar dalelein lekar aaye toh yeh apne paas ke ilm par nazan hone lage, poori do aayton tak. Is se Fatah Makkah murad nahi. Fatah Makkah wale din toh Rasool Allah ﷺ ne kafiron ko islam lana qubul farmaya tha aur taqriban do hazaar aadmi us din musalman huye the. Agar is ayat mein yahi Fatah Makkah murad hoti toh chahiye tha ke Allah ke paighambar Alaihis Salam un ka islam qubul na farmate, jaise is ayat mein hai ke us din kafiron ka islam lana maqbool hoga. Balke yahan murad fatah se faisla hai jaise Quran mein hai ayat: (Faftah baini wa bainahum fatchan wa najjini wa man ma'iya minal-mu'minin) (Ash-Shu'ara: 118) Hamare darmiyan toh fatah kar yaani faisla kar. Aur jaise aur maqam par hai ayat: (Qul yajma'u bainana rabbunna thumma yaftahu bainana bil-haqqi wa huwal-fattahul-'alim) (Saba: 26) Yaani Allah Ta'ala hamein jama karega phir hamare aapas ke faisle farmayega. Aur ayat mein hai: (Wastaftahu wa khaba kullu jabbarin 'anid) (Ibrahim: 15) Yeh faisla chahte hain, sarkash ziddi tabah huye. Aur jagah hai ayat: (Wa kanu min qablu yastaftihuna 'alal-ladhina kafaru) (Al-Baqarah: 89) Is se pehle woh kafiron par fatah chahte the. Aur ayat mein farman-e-bari hai ayat: (In tastaftihu faqad ja'akumul-fath) (Al-Anfal: 19) Agar tum faisle ke aarzumand ho toh fatah aa gayi.
